latency_scope: Warm per-query CPU latency after models and indexes are loaded; one-time process/model startup is excluded.
runtime_variation_note: Ranks are deterministic for fixed model/runtime inputs. Wall-clock latency and very small floating-point differences may vary with CPU, PyTorch, and BLAS versions. Stable chunk-id tie breaks are applied.
